description: "Domestic Animals" by Richard Lamb Allen is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. This work offers a comprehensive exploration of various domestic animals, specifically focusing on their history, management, breeding, and diseases, with an emphasis on practical applications for stock-breeders and graziers aiming for economic efficiency.
